text:
kim: Quick heads-up — tonight's merge window at 23:45 UTC. Any hotfix PRs that need to go must have 2x LGTM and CI green by 23:30 or we push to the next slot. Pls ping reviewers now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mira: Got it. I have #6221 (kv-cache edge case) in review, requesting second reviewer. Link: https://git.company/repo/pull/6221 :eyes:

alex: I'm on #6221 now. Will run locally and check the repro steps. ETA 10m.

jen: I can do a quick pass on tests for #6223 (scheduling race). Pushing a tiny fix if flaky.

sanjay: FYI smoke stage is green but load test hasn't been run since the last change. Will kick off a short perf job now.

mira: Thanks @alex — leaving a small comment about null handling, should be trivial.

alex: Comment addressed, pushed. Running unit tests.

deploy-bot: preflight-check — PR #6221: CI passed, LGTM count = 1. Merge blocked: requires 2 approvals.

kim: @jen @sanjay can one of you give second look on #6221? It's small and fixes customer-facing error. We need 2x by 23:30.

jen: Taking it. Quick scan... looks fine. :thumbsup: LGTM from jen.

deploy-bot: pr-update — PR #6221: LGTM count = 2. CI passed. Merge queued for 23:40 UTC as part of hotfix window.

mira: Awesome. I'll watch the merge and make sure the post-merge smoke runs.

kim: Thanks team. If anything flaps, we'll rollback and schedule follow-up. If anyone needs a hand with the next one (#6223), @alex I'll grab it after deploy.

alex: Copy that, standing by.

jen: Nice — moving to the next review.

deploy-bot: deploy-notice — Hotfix merge executed at 23:40 UTC. Post-merge smoke passed. :white_check_mark:
